research_question: For every complex polynomial P of degree 32, are the power, Dickson and quadratic-over-power rows exactly the cases with q(P,dx) at most 3?

theorem_target.statement: For every P in C[x] of degree 32, q(P,dx)<=3 if and only if P is affine-equivalent to x^32, D_32(x,a) with a nonzero, or x^32+A*x^16 with A nonzero.
theorem_target.normalisation: monic and centred in the source, with an additive target constant suppressed
theorem_target.rank_three_prediction: No degree-32 polynomial has exact fixed-seed cyclic rank 3.

coverage.support_rule: every subset S of {1,...,31} with 1 in S and |S|<=3

method.coordinate_model: support-constrained inverse series F(y)=1+sum u_i*y^i and the triangular coefficient map from P(tF(1/t))=t^32
method.depth_rule: Groebner basis through 4d; reduce all additional confinement equations through 6d
certificate_types: full allowed coordinate space matched by a saturating family
nilpotence of every non-power inverse coordinate modulo the Groebner basis
radical containment in the union of predicted rank-two components
method.family_containment_control: three deterministic points per predicted component over the fixed 61-bit prime
method.verification_execution: python -O must regenerate a byte-identical mathematical receipt

adjudication.confirmed: all 466 cases close with the preregistered outcome counts and no anomaly or missing certificate
adjudication.falsified: an exact case produces a component outside the three predicted families or a dimension larger than predicted
adjudication.partial: all cases have no anomaly but one or more radical-containment certificates are not established
adjudication.inconclusive: the exact computation fails, exhausts resources, or does not complete both primary and optimized verification

stopping_rule: Run the sealed ordinary computation once. If it completes, run the preregistered optimized replay. Do not modify depths, predicted families, certificate bounds or adjudication after inspecting results; any repair is a successor protocol.
claim_boundary: The quantified statement covers every complex polynomial of degree 32, but only classifies the threshold q(P,dx)<=3.
For a polynomial outside the three families, the conclusion is q(P,dx)>=4; its exact higher rank is not classified.
The result is a finite computer-assisted theorem candidate over Q-defined universal confinement ideals, not a proof-assistant object.
It does not prove the all-degree coefficient atlas.
Within-programme ordinary and optimized replay is not external independent reproduction.
